sentences.text:
on 11 November, 2019
 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6557 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the order dated 13.09.2019 against the petitioner, in Crl.M.P.No.1472 of 2019 in CC No.146 of 2015 on the file of V Additional Munsif Magistrate, Guntur.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that offence under which the petitioner is charged under Section 59 (1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is punishable with fine only.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the lower court rejected the application on the ground of ill health of the petitioner is not bonafide and that the signature of the petitioner is also not present in the petition.
He further submits that as the offence punishable under this petition is not of a serious nature, application of the petitioner can be considered on its own merits.

On hearing of the arguments of learned counsel for the petitioner, this court is of the opinion that an opportunity should be given to the petitioner, permitting him to appear before the lower court and on such the application of the petitioner shall be considered by the court on the same day subject to the exigencies of work.
With these observations, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.

As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions,
if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.

___ D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 11.11.2019 GR Lakkireddy Venkata Subba Reddy A vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150506553/
